scope: Independent single-batch review of the eight original saved focused answer/choice viewport screenshots; visible pixels only.

observations: Answers 1 and 2 occupy a consistent centered text column. Their lines remain readable and within the column, with no visible collision or right-edge truncation.
Number headings, paragraphs and horizontal separators have clear vertical separation. The short final line of answer 1 is intact.
The visible opening of answer 3 follows the same alignment and line spacing. No figure is visible, so there is no figure-framing judgment.
limits: Answer 3 continues below the saved bottom edge; its remainder is not inspected or treated as container clipping.

observations.visibleArea: Tail of the preceding answer and complete visible answer 6, including the application list and mathematical paragraph.
observations: The heading, introductory sentence and three numbered application entries remain distinct. Wrapped list lines fit within the column without overlapping adjacent entries.
The mathematical paragraph has visible vertical space around the inline inequality, phase symbol, fraction, equation label and scientific notation. None visibly collide with neighboring prose.
The final paragraph line is fully inside the saved viewport with space below it. No figure is visible.
limits: The preceding answer extends beyond the top edge, which limits evidence about that answer rather than proving clipping.
Small subscript glyphs and fraction details are not individually certified, and no mathematical or language-semantic approval is inferred from their appearance.

observations.visibleArea: Complete question 1 with options A-D, and the opening portion of question 2.
observations: Question 1 wraps across readable lines without leaving its text column. All four option bodies are visible and separated vertically.
Radio circles and letter labels occupy separate aligned columns; wrapped option lines maintain their text indentation rather than intruding into the controls.
The separator below question 1 and the question 2 prompt are clear. The visible question 2 options retain the same spacing, with no visible overlap. No figure is present.
limits: Question 2 continues below the bottom edge, with only the beginning of its option C visible; unseen options are not judged.
The pictured radio controls establish appearance only, not selection behavior or correctness.

observations.visibleArea: Tail of the preceding question and complete question 6 with options A-F.

All six square controls, letter labels and option bodies are visible. Wrapped lines align with their option text, and the longer option E remains separate from options D and F.

The preceding inline 1/n expressions have visible separation from surrounding words. Option F ends above the bottom edge with whitespace below; no definite text clipping, collision or figure-framing issue is visible.
limits: The preceding question begins outside the saved top edge.
Checkbox behavior and choice semantics are outside this static-pixel review.

observations.visibleArea: Complete answer 1 and the heading and opening paragraph of answer 2.
observations: Answer 1 wraps into the narrow column with visible left and right margins. Its lines and final sentence remain readable without horizontal truncation or interline overlap.
The number 1 heading, answer body, separator and number 2 heading have distinct vertical spacing.
The visible answer 2 lines follow the same column and remain inside the side margins. No figure is visible.

observations.visibleArea: Answer 6 heading, complete three-entry application list, and the opening mathematical paragraph.

The mathematical paragraph starts after clear whitespace. Its visible inequality fits on its line with the following prose, and the phase symbol has adequate visible separation from the surrounding text.

Small subscript identities are not precisely certified from the supplied pixels.

observations.visibleArea: Complete question 1 prompt, complete options A-C, and the beginning of option D.
observations: The prompt wraps within the mobile margins, ending before the first option with a clear gap.
Options A-C have separate radio and letter columns. Their multi-line bodies maintain a consistent hanging text indentation and do not overlap the controls or each other.
The beginning of option D follows the same alignment. All visible text fits horizontally; no figure is visible.
limits: Option D continues beyond the saved bottom edge, so its full wrapping and the next question are not inspected.
No control interaction or answer correctness is certified.

observations.visibleArea: Complete question 6 prompt, complete options A-D, and the start of option E.
observations: The four-line prompt is readable within the mobile side margins and is clearly separated from option A.
Square controls, letter labels and text form stable separate columns. Options A-D wrap without horizontal clipping and retain visible gaps between option groups.
Option D's final line is intact, and the start of option E is aligned below it. No definite overlap, container clipping or figure-framing defect is visible.

This screenshot does not establish checkbox operation, scrolling or unseen choice states.

conclusion: No definite visible clipping, overlap, mathematical-spacing collision or framing defect was found in the eight inspected saved originals. PASS is confined to the portions actually visible; it is not automatic or complete-surface approval.
staticViewLimits: Exactly the eight manifest originals were viewed once each in one fresh image batch. No reopen, crop, zoom, derived image or other image was used.
Saved viewport boundaries limit evidence. Content continuing above or below a screenshot is not by itself a broken container.
No figures appear in these focused captures; figure fidelity, unseen figure framing and instructional figure detail are not certified.
Readable visible prose and gross mathematical spacing were inspected, but precise small glyphs, font identity and font metrics are not certified.
Source fidelity, science, new English, choice semantics, native and DOM approvals are reused as directed, not independently re-reviewed or newly established here.
The DOM report named by the manifest was not opened. Manifest bytes and hashes are retained as supplied bindings, not claimed as newly recomputed checks.
No interaction, judging, keyboard behavior, scrolling, ARIA, complete English accessibility, fonts, unseen states or headed acceptance is certified.
closesReadyScope: This independent saved-pixel-only batch is complete and ready to close; no ticket closure, publication or broader acceptance is authorized.
